rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Home loses vs not: square-root-profit weighting
Choose max probability x sqrt(odds - 1). One unit total per match.
Home-not-lose odds are synthesized by splitting the stake between recorded home-win and draw odds.

g.text: Synthetic payout = 1 / (1 / home odds + 1 / draw odds). These are not quoted double-chance prices.
Assumes both component bets can be placed at recorded prices with fractional stakes; excludes fees and rounding.
